title: Add stepcontrolled RAG scenario kit and tool-negotiation samples
author: Sofia Li
release_notes: Introduce a lightweight scenario-driven RAG playbook (stepcontrolled flow) and TypeScript agent samples demonstrating tool-negotiation patterns. Useful for quickstarts, authoring labs, and reproducible e2e tests.
description:
Context: Teams building RAG-enabled agents often need examples that show predictable control over step execution, structured clarification turns, and graceful tool fallback. This PR introduces a compact 'stepcontrolled' playbook pattern and accompanying TypeScript agent examples that demonstrate a negotiation-style tool-calling protocol (tool-negotiation) for multi-tool workflows.

Motivation: Existing quickstarts show tool-calling and retrieval, but they assume either fully-committed tool selection or free-form agent decisions. For production workflows (customer-facing assistants, regulated decision flows), we need deterministic step boundaries and explicit negotiation signals so downstream systems can assert invariants and instrument SLAs. The new materials lower onboarding time for teams that want reproducible stepwise debugging and telemetry hooks.

What this PR adds: (single continuous description) - docs/rag/stepcontrolled-playbook.md: narrative and reference for the stepcontrolled pattern, state model, and telemetry hooks (prefix, step tokens, assertion points). - examples/agents/ts/tool-negotiation-sample/: a minimal TypeScript agent shim that performs retrieval, proposes candidate tools, negotiates a single tool selection via a structured clarification turn, and executes with retries and fallback. - examples/agents/ts/tool-negotiation-sample/README.md: quickstart and local run instructions (devcontainer + env example). - static/images/stepcontrolled-lifecycle.svg: architecture diagram showing sequencing, KV cache checkpoints, and telemetry probes. - docs/snippets/stepcontrolled-eval.yaml: an example evaluation scenario (step assertions) for the harness. - site config update to add new quickstart tile and SEO metadata.

Checklist: - [x] Author docs and examples - [x] Add unit smoke for TS example (local run) - [x] Lint docs (mkdocs) - [x] Add schematic evaluation snippet - [x] Add telemetry probe points to diagram

Notes and links: - Linear: ENG-6124 for design and ENG-6125 for the TS shim implementation. - Local reproduction: follow README in the TS sample; it spins a local mini-index and an in-memory tool stub. - This PR is intentionally small in runtime scope but aims to be a composable pattern for larger authoring kits.

Files changed are small and targeted; no runtime library changes are included in this PR. For adoption guidance, see the final section in docs/rag/stepcontrolled-playbook.md.

summary: Add a stepcontrolled RAG playbook and TypeScript tool-negotiation sample to demonstrate deterministic step boundaries and structured tool selection for reproducible RAG workflows.
motivation: Provide a composable quickstart that reduces cognitive load for teams wanting deterministic, auditable RAG flows with clear telemetry and evaluation hooks.
